mapper.select: SELECT id, category, badge_class AS badgeClass, title, description, published_date AS publishedDate, source, news_url AS newsUrl, created_at AS createdAt FROM news ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (category, badge_class, title, description, published_date, source, news_url) VALUES (#{category}, #{badgeClass}, #{title}, #{description}, #{publishedDate}, #{source}, #{newsUrl})
